DraftCraft Pro 1.18.0, a screenplay writing app inspired by Final Draft, for **macOS (Apple Silicon)** and **Windows (x64)**. Open source under the MIT licence.

## Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | `DraftCraft-Pro-1.18.0-x64-Setup.exe` (installer), or `DraftCraft-Pro-1.18.0-win-x64-portable.zip` (no install) |
| macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon | `DraftCraft-Pro-1.18.0-arm64.dmg` |

Checksums: `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`; the DMG's SHA-256 is `c1cf0456e13b7a69b78ef562fdd5e2b494a7e8ac99e5330d85ddab0718d2d084`.

## New in 1.18.0
- **Start Window** at launch: new script (default template or six one-click formats), Open…, Recent Projects (filter, show the file, remove, missing files marked), Learn, and Continue. Untick "Show this window when DraftCraft Pro opens" to skip it.
- **Recent projects** in File › Open Recent, with Clear Menu.
- **Emoji picker**: the Emoji toolbar button, right-click › Insert Emoji…, or Insert › Emoji…. Search, categories, Recently Used, keyboard control; one Undo removes it.
- **Getting Started** text now wraps to the window.

Full notes: [CHANGELOG-1.18.0.md](https://github.com/hridyakshgejwal-star/DraftCraft-Pro/blob/main/CHANGELOG-1.18.0.md).

## Install
**Windows.** Run the Setup file. It installs for your user without administrator rights, adds a Start menu shortcut, and opens `.draftcraft` projects; Final Draft and Fountain scripts get DraftCraft Pro under "Open with". The app is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. See [WINDOWS.md](https://github.com/hridyakshgejwal-star/DraftCraft-Pro/blob/main/WINDOWS.md).

**Mac.** Open the DMG and double-click **Install-DraftCraft.command**. The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized: if macOS blocks the installer, open it once, then choose System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway.

## Tested
- **Mac DMG.** 20/20 release suites, 288 unit tests, and the real-Electron Start Window, lifecycle, save and PDF-parity checks. On an Apple M2 Mac the image check passed and the native self-test passed 16/16 ([MAC-CHECK-1.18.0.md](https://github.com/hridyakshgejwal-star/DraftCraft-Pro/blob/main/MAC-CHECK-1.18.0.md)).
- **Windows build.** Built from this source on a Windows runner by GitHub Actions, where the unit tests and the app's native self-test run on the packaged app. The results are in the workflow run's summary.
